diagnosis.defectLocation: The selected R1, test proposal and binding incorrectly predicted unquoted literal renderer titles for the first six object-parameterized it.each cases. The test source itself did not change. The runner correctly refused the exact literal-name mismatch against that erroneous binding.
formatterChain: it.each receives each object row as items=[row], then calls formatTitle before test registration (collector59908 lines838–864).

formatTitle first handles printf placeholders. This template has no percent placeholders, so format(template) leaves it unchanged. It then replaces $operation, $projectPath and $authoritative using objectAttr and objDisplay, not String (lines950–960).
@vitest/utils reexports objDisplay from chunk-_commonjsHelpers.js. That implementation calls loupe.inspect with default truncate40 and returns its representation.

The actual @vitest/utils importer-local link resolves to loupe3.2.1. package.json has type=module and main/module=./lib/index.js. lib/index.js dispatches primitive strings to inspectString, null to literal null, and booleans to String(value).

lib/string.js wraps string values in single quotes after escaping and truncate(string, options.truncate-2). helpers.js defaults colorsfalse and stylizeString. The operation strings have6/7characters and the path has34characters, below the38-character content limit, so there is no truncation.
Later `%s` cases follow utils format's String(value) path for these primitive strings and booleans, explaining why their literal names remain unquoted and match the binding.
